placements.frame: Is this rehearsal or drill practice being formalized into a recurring, owned cadence — and does the rationale offered treat unexercised capability as no capability at all?
placements.why: src-1 and src-3 both fix a monthly cadence for Atlas rollback rehearsals (enactment and record of the same decision), src-2 supplies the justifying principle that an unrehearsed rollback is not a real rollback, and src-4 anchors the practice to a single named accountable owner. Together these four segments constitute a single coherent theme this envelope contributes: rollback readiness is being institutionalized as a standing, owned, recurring practice rather than left as a one-time or informal capability. This is a subject future envelopes (subsequent drill reports, cadence revisions, ownership changes, near-miss postmortems) will keep feeding, not a one-time fact — so it clears the narrative grain test rather than being a fact folded into some other leaf. No existing narrative leaves are supplied to reuse, and nothing close enough exists to justify an INSPIRED lineage edge, so this is a NEW mint placed under the newly minted Organization strata.
